app_metadata.target_audience: Indian Small Businesses (shops, Kirana, restaurants, medical stores, service businesses)
app_metadata.design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast with Warm Premium Accents (Tactile Utility)
app_metadata.nav_structure: Mobile: Fixed Bottom Navigation Bar | Desktop: Left Collapsible/Static Sidebar

layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav_mobile: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-[#171717] text-[#F7F5F0] z-50 flex items-center justify-around border-t border-[#27272A] md:hidden
layout_and_spacing.sidebar_desktop: hidden md:flex flex-col w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 bottom-0 bg-[#171717] text-[#F7F5F0] border-r border-[#27272A] z-40 p-4
layout_and_spacing.main_content_wrapper: min-h-screen bg-[#F7F5F0] text-[#171717] pb-20 md:pb-8 md:pl-64 pt-4 px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8

buttons.primary: bg-[#8B1E2D] hover:bg-[#701824] text-white font-medium px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C6A15B] focus:outline-none
buttons.secondary: bg-[#171717] hover:bg-[#262626] text-[#F7F5F0] font-medium px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg border border-[#333333] active:scale-[0.98] transition-colors
buttons.accent: bg-[#C6A15B] hover:bg-[#B38F4A] text-[#171717] font-semibold px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98] transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-[#171717]/20 hover:bg-[#171717]/5 text-[#171717] font-medium px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg transition-colors

cards.stat_card: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm hover:border-[#C6A15B]/50 transition-all
cards.profile_card: bg-white border border-stone-200 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm

status_badges.present: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
status_badges.absent: bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
status_badges.pending: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
status_badges.paid: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
status_badges.overdue: bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-300 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold
status_badges.half_day: bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-300 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold

tables.container: w-full overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-stone-200 bg-white shadow-sm
tables.header: bg-[#171717] text-[#F7F5F0] text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold py-3 px-4 text-left
tables.row: border-b border-stone-100 hover:bg-stone-50 transition-colors text-sm text-[#171717]

animation_guidelines.philosophy: Fast, subtle micro-feedback only. Avoid heavy decorative entrance or continuous animations.
animation_guidelines.modals_drawers: Use basic Vaul drawer for mobile bottom sheets and simple Radix dialog for desktop modals with minimal fade/slide-up

testing_requirements.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, submit buttons, stat cards, tab triggers, inputs, navigation links, and action menus MUST include explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='staff-add-btn', data-testid='attendance-mark-present', data-testid='total-payable-card').

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow mobile-first architecture: bottom nav bar on screen width < 768px, sidebar on desktop >= 768px.
Use color palette tokens strictly: Primary Burgundy #8B1E2D, Charcoal #171717, Gold #C6A15B, Warm Ivory #F7F5F0.
Keep components clean and fast. Minimal animations per user preference.
Use sonner for notifications and Radix / Shadcn components customized to match palette.
Add data-testid to every interactive element and stat card for automated test support.
